facts.fact: 本章时间：1898 年 9 月
婚期已满八周，Caroline 对自己与身边的世界都失去了信心
facts.anchor: After eight weeks of marriage, I’d lost faith in myself, as well as the world around me.

facts.fact: 舞会举办地是纽约最隐居的富商 Zane Bishop 的宅邸，七十五个房间，从不见客
facts.anchor: “This place” was the home of one of New York’s most reclusive tycoons, Mr. Zane Bishop. No one ever saw him, and he didn’t receive guests at his seventy-five-room mansion.

facts.fact: Orson 的妻子 Camilla Bishop Marshall 说服兄长 Zane 主办这场为「改善穷人状况协会」募款的舞会
facts.anchor: Somehow Camilla Bishop Marshall had convinced her brother to host tonight’s ball as a benefit for the Association for Improving the Condition of the Poor.

facts.fact: Caroline 梳着时髦发式、穿着新做的 Worth 礼服出门，认定自己看起来完美无缺
facts.anchor: With my hair coiffed in an elegant sweep and my new Worth gown, I knew I looked perfect.

facts.fact: Mr. Barbey 提起Caroline 二人是在 Bar Harbor 度蜜月
facts.anchor: “I hear you honeymooned in Bar Harbor, Mrs. Grey.

facts.fact: Mrs. Barbey 对 Van de Hart 说 Caroline 无聊透顶，Orson 娶她只为了带在身边好看
facts.anchor: She bores Orson to tears. He only married her to look good on his arm, not for her personality.

facts.fact: 花园长椅上的陌生男子正是 Zane Bishop
facts.anchor: The man in the darkness had been Zane Bishop.

facts.fact: Caroline 婚前私下买下子宫帽（womb veil）避孕
facts.anchor: This was why I secretly used a womb veil to prevent consequences.

facts.fact: Orson 说次日要随几位朋友去宾夕法尼亚狩猎
facts.anchor: “Incidentally, I’m accompanying some fellows on a hunting trip in Pennsylvania tomorrow.
